contracts.name: Plug-in initializer
contracts.evidence: The original indirect initializer call pushes zero context and callback 2CBE20. Both known plug-in initializers consume that same two-argument contract.

contracts.name: Directory visitor registration
contracts.evidence: The original routine stores callback/context at 93A340/93A344. Directory enumeration at 2D65C0 invokes that callback with each original directory entry.

contracts.name: XRegisterThreadNotifyRoutine
contracts.evidence: Original registration links the supplied 12-byte record. XapiCallThreadNotifyRoutines calls its function at +8 with the thread-creation flag. CRT initialization writes callback 3141D9 to record field 9546DC before registering 9546D4.

contracts.name: C++ array constructor iterator
contracts.evidence: Original helper consumes base, element size, count and constructor, ending in RET 10h. It calls argument 3 for each element with ECX set to that element.

contracts.name: C++ exception-safe array constructor iterator
contracts.evidence: Original named CRT helper ??_L consumes base, element size, count, constructor and destructor, ending in RET 14h. The loop at 30C58D calls argument 3 with ECX set to each element. Its cleanup at 30C5C0 forwards argument 4 to __ArrayUnwind.

contracts.name: C++ array unwind destructor iterator
contracts.evidence: Original named __ArrayUnwind helper decrements the element count, subtracts the size, and calls argument 3 with ECX set to that element. It ends in RET 10h.

contracts.evidence: Original five-argument resource loader copies argument 4 to request record +28 at E1E76..E1E7E. Completion at E2277 calls that callback with result and request. Original synchronous adapter 23360 supplies completion 232B0 and waits through the same scheduler.

evidence: The kernel parameter layouts match the native host service contracts. The XAPI routine was checked from 00309872 through RET 18h; it forwards argument 2 as the start routine to PsCreateSystemThreadEx, with system entry 003097DA. The original entry pushes user routine 00309426. Only literal callback values proven in the contiguous argument-building block are recovered.
